posts.name: Gurmander Singh Maan
posts.cooked:
@Subendu

@santhanakrishnan

I had Deep GenAI, MLP, TDS, and System Commands this term. The end-term exams for Deep GenAI and TDS were scheduled in the morning session. However, due to a misunderstanding, I attended the System Commands and MLP exams in the morning instead.

Will this cause any issues with the System Commands and MLP exams, or is it fine? Could someone please clarify?

Thanks.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: You need to attend the exam in your specific slot otherwise it will not be considered. I think that is also mentioned in the hall ticket. If it was mentioned you need to do TDS and GenAI in FN then their scores from AN slot will not be considered same goes for SC and MLP.

posts.name: Gurmander Singh Maan
posts.cooked:
Can you please make an exception for this case? Otherwise, I’ve to repeat all 4 courses again. And kindly provide the email for support team if possible.

I also shared this with the examination staff in the afternoon. Since I had already attempted the morning exam, we assumed that the SysComm and MLP exams in the afternoon session would be the same. Therefore, I attempted TDS in the later session, as we believed that attempting SysComm and MLP again could be a violation, given that I had already seen the exam in the morning session.

Thx

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Not really something we can do. As per policy, only subjects you were supposed to attempt are considered. You might have to repeat all four subjects.
